label: preparing
what: A surprise evening community hospitality gathering/feast in the great hall at 18:00, with lanterns and a 200-loaf catering delivery; innkeeper and freight identify it as a community gathering. The builder is coordinating hall supplies and lighting. Baker supplied the loaves, and neighbour knowingly helps by spreading the invitation; secretary learned and conveyed the plans, but appears an informed town aide rather than an organizer. The exact occasion remains undisclosed.
